fields.label: Package Help
fields.options:
Full Business: Sales + Purchases + Stock + Accounts.
Accounts and Stock: no separate Selling/Buying modules (invoices and receipts stay under Accounts and Stock).
Accounts Only: ledgers, payments, reports.
Stock Only: items, warehouses, movements, stock reports.

After saving, refresh the page (Ctrl+F5). Nothing is deleted; you can switch package at any time.
